lean.fidelity_note: The formal statement retains the frequency supports $2\Lambda$ and $4\Lambda$, oddness, incompressibility, the tail estimate (5.56), and the one-sided pressure bound (5.57). It allows the broader parent-pressure class and a nonzero seed bounded by $\lambda^{-3/4}$ without requiring an attained peak; the paper’s choices remain included. The two terms on the left of the second estimate in (5.56) may be evaluated at independent times, so the formal conclusion controls the sum of their time suprema. Existence of the cutoff velocity and its zero-mean Poisson pressure is explicit, with constants chosen before the parent, depth and cutoff frequency; uniqueness follows from the cutoff identity and uniqueness of normalized periodic pressure.
